review_description: Great price, service and installation, the install crew were very professional especially Thomas.
From quotation to installation everything went off with a hitch, no surprises. I would unhesitatingly recommend Solargain to any prospective purchaser.

I found Solargain to be competitive and extremely efficient.  They were quick to respond to quotes and installation.  Communication was great.  On site the staff were professional and punctual, doing the install quickly and effectively and explaining the process very well.  I'd highly recommend Solargain to others.
Great team and very professional company. So easy to deal with. Highly recommended!
The quoting was good, the installation was punctual & tidy the customer service was good James organised installation inspection
Easy quoting process.Installation process was easy.Very professional and easy to deal with

Appreciated the visit in the quote process.Organisation of installation date most understanding of my needs.The crew were friendly, skilled and efficient. They explained everything clearly and patiently.A good experience for us.

Very impressed with Solargain Wangaratta in every aspect of their business. The quote was given immediately after my request. The installation was extremely fast after my acceptance of the quote and the install crew were professional, friendly and quick. Went beyond my expectations. I would recommend them to anyone.

Blake was beyond great with his friendly and informative assistance when we went into Solargain for information and a quote.The installation was a real eye opener as the guys who installed our system worked as a team and really impressed me as they just knew what they were doing and did a fantastic job!!! Everything they did looks neat and tidy and they impressed me by making sure everything they did looked as neat and perfect as possible.Their friendly and courteous attitude was just an added bonus!!!

Solargain Wangaratta were very professional throughout the sales and installation process. They were also able to remove our old pool heating roof matting and install an inverter pool heater as part of the project.   They were flexible in the design and installation and were able to add 5 more panels to provide 40 in total at minimal additional cost.

This is the 2nd system I have purchased from Solargain and I have organised another 3 systems for friends and family with other branches of Solargain as well. All of them have been positive experiences.This one with Solargain Wangaratta was for a rental property. Their whole process from my perspective as landlord and property owner of quoting, system design, delivery and installation was quick and painless.Specifically, their sensistive interaction with our tenant was an important aspect as was the technical quality and price of the system, a 6.6kW system with a Fronius inverter and Akcome 440W Kookaburra panels.The tenant, a single senior lady was effusive in her praise of the way the installers handled the whole installation process including how they politely kept her informed and worked with minimal disruption leaving a neat clean result.I have no hesitation in recommending them.

The entire process from inception to completion was conducted with skill and professionalism. The entire house and site was left clean and tidy. The system was commissioned shortly after completion .I would be pleased to recommend Solargain Wangaratta to any prospective client.

Right from initial contact, the Solargain Team at Wangaratta was helpful, friendly and very willing to provide all the information we needed to make an informed decision. Fabulous customer service and support.They presented us with 2 quotes containing 2 different inverters- battery ready and both quotes contained the government rebates and Air to Energy Hot water service. The quote contained an aerial photo of the property showing the position of the solar panels. The representative came to the house and applied for the government rebates we were entitled to, which was very helpful.The team attended the property within 5 days of signing up to install the solar and hot water, which took 2 days.Once the installation was completed they organised the compliance inspection and forwarded all the necessary documents for gird connection to our supplier.

From the very first contact, the team at Solargain Wangaratta have been both professional and extremely helpful. The installation had to be deferred a couple of times and Garath was very accomodating. Tom and his crew did a great installation and Tom followed up with help, over the phone, on setting up WEB access to my system. The communication with all in their team, from sales, install team to back-office, was fantastic. The team were always keen to answer any questions that my wife or I had, and they went out of their way to help us through the process. The quality of the panels and the placement was superb. The WEB interface to the FRONIUS inverter is well laid out and easy to read. The black panels look great and seem very efficient. I cannot recommend  the Solargain Wang. team more highly.

Gareth responded to my telephone enquiry with a punctual and informative on site inspection and appraisal of our ideas and was then most helpful in assisting me with submission of the online application which due to my technology challenged status, or old age made that process much easier.We reached agreement on a mutually agreeable installation date and with a confirmation call the day prior the crew arrived on site on 30th May, and with Tom directing the process a very courteous tidy team had the job completed mid afternoon same day and departed with our thanks and a chocolate bar each. Too early for a beer they said.The following day I received eMail copies of all the documents which had been forwarded to the Electrical Inspector for his attention and a compliance check before connection to the grid.We had been made aware that this part of the process could take up to 35 days but fortuitously it was inspected 16 days after the installation and since then we have had a very cold cloudy spell apart from one reasonable day where I noted the inverter reading at 4400.For that reason alone it is difficult for me to make an objective comment on the performance of the system and its value.As an aside, the energy supplier texted to say (shortly after the installation) that our system was not inputting to the 'smart meter' and we should check the system. I informed him that the system was awaiting an inspection, the application for which his office would have been aware of. Perhaps the meter is smarter than the Supplier!!Please note that due to removing a smaller system which had previously attracted a Solar benefit from Government we were not eligible to claim again. There was also additional electrical work done at our request which impacted the price.

Solargain Wangaratta were happy to supply the product I was requesting which entailed Fronius inverter coupled with BYD battery and Jinko Tiger Neo panels. Solargain were innovative in the consideration of panel locations. The installation was efficient and professionally managed. The electrical work was first class and the finished product was extremely tidy. They handled all aspects of the job with ease. The job also included the removal of older panels and inverters.

Happy customer.
